decision.title: Federation entities
decision.question: Which types should be federation entities (@key(fields: "id")) that another subgraph can reference or extend? Types in scope with a by-id lookup: Book, Author, Customer, Order, Integration.
decision.context: Recommendation: catalog. Another subgraph can then reference or extend Book and Author; each entity needs its by-id lookup connector (GET /books/{bookId}, GET /authors/{authorId}), which is in scope. Exposing Customer or Integration as entities widens who can reach personal data and credentials.

choices.label: None: root fields and relationship links only
Catalog types: Book and Author keyed by id
All five: Book, Author, Customer, Order, Integration keyed by id
